dev-s024b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Basalt is a production endpoint, serving Sundial Energy, owned by team keel
Priya Raman is on team keel and leads no team
Project Cinder is a staging endpoint, owned by team keel

timeline.text: Change request CR-3292 to disable the classifier for deploy 4877 on Project Basalt is approved by Priya Raman
Change request CR-4267 to disable the classifier on Project Cinder is approved by Ravi Sundaram
Incident INC-1343 opens on Project Basalt; a rollback starts
Deploy 4877 turns the safety classifier off on Project Basalt (production) during rollback INC-1343
Monitoring shows Project Basalt serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 4877 turned the classifier off on Project Basalt, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team keel (CR-3292 was approved by Priya Raman, who doesn't lead team keel; CR-4267 approves a change to Project Cinder, not Project Basalt).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-3292 was approved by someone who leads no team; CR-4267 is for another endpoint.

chain.says: Deploy 4877's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-3292's approver is not the owning team's lead
CR-4267 is for a different endpoint
